name: oxford_iiit_pet
description: The Oxford-IIIT Pet dataset contains images of 37 pet breeds with breed labels and pixel-level segmentation masks. It is used to evaluate fine-grained image classification and semantic segmentation methods on animals. The dataset is widely used for benchmarking and educational purposes in computer vision.
reputation: Widely used benchmark for fine-grained pet breed classification and segmentation; popular in computer vision research and education.
